problems.title: The DataScienceCluster waits on an upgrade gate
problems.description: Before provisioning a new version, the operator checks upgrade gates. An unacknowledged gate blocks provisioning until an administrator sets its key to "true" in ConfigMap odh-upgrade-acks. This is a deliberate manual step, not a bug. The operator cannot work out which release the gates are for. That happens when an older operator runs over resources a newer version created (a downgrade, or an install of an older build); acknowledging does not help.
evidence: DataScienceCluster default-dsc: Ready=False (Error): failed to resolve upgrade gate version: unable to determine target release for upgrade gates
DataScienceCluster default-dsc: ModulesReady=False (AdminAckRequired): Waiting for upgrade gates to be acknowledged
problems.fix: Read what each gate is about (the operator's release notes name it), then acknowledge it with the commands below. Install the operator version that created these resources, or a newer one (Update on the Status page).
problems.technicalCmd: oc patch configmap odh-upgrade-acks -n redhat-ods-operator --type merge -p '{"data":{"kserve-v2":"true"}}'
